conventions: TypeScript strict mode with ES modules; use `import type` for type-only imports and keep `@excalidraw/common` / `@excalidraw/element` imports grouped before relative imports.

Never leave `textRanges: undefined` or `textRanges: []` as an own property on any `ExcalidrawTextElement`; omit the `textRanges` key or `delete` it when empty so Vitest element and scene snapshots remain byte-for-byte identical.
Do not add fields to `AppState` in `packages/excalidraw/appState.ts` or alter default toolbar/panel DOM when not editing text, preserving existing `appState` and UI snapshots.
Use Vitest (`describe`, `it`, `expect`, `vi`) and `@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/test-utils` (`render`, `act`, `waitFor`) for unit and integration tests without adding new `toMatchSnapshot` calls.

Apply dark-mode colour transformation via `applyDarkModeFilter(color, theme === THEME.DARK)` from `@excalidraw/common` for both foreground text runs and background highlight rectangles in Canvas and SVG renderers.

decisions.topic: Live edit-time display mechanism for per-range text colour and highlight (FR-9, AC-3)
decisions.choice: Render `editingTextElement` on the static canvas when `editingTextElement.textRanges?.length` is non-empty by retaining it in `packages/excalidraw/scene/Renderer.ts` (`getRenderableElementsMap`) and folding `editingTextElement.versionNonce` into `canvasNonce` (`getRenderableElements`), while `packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.tsx` sets `editable.style.color = "transparent"`, `editable.style.caretColor = applyDarkModeFilter(updatedTextElement.strokeColor, appState.theme === THEME.DARK)`, and `editable.dataset.textRanges = JSON.stringify(updatedTextElement.textRanges)`; in jsdom, `packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.test.tsx` deterministically asserts against `editor.style.color === "transparent"`, `JSON.parse(editor.dataset.textRanges!)`, and `h.app.renderer.getRenderableElements(...).elementsMap.get(textElement.id)?.textRanges` while `h.state.editingTextElement` is open.
rejected: Replacing the `<textarea class="excalidraw-wysiwyg">` with a `contenteditable` div containing `<span>` nodes
Rendering a mirrored HTML `<div>/<span>` overlay inside `.excalidraw-textEditorContainer` while keeping `editingTextElement` excluded from `Renderer.ts`
decisions.reason: (a) Normally `packages/excalidraw/scene/Renderer.ts` `getRenderableElementsMap` skips `editingTextElement` and `packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.tsx` paints the `<textarea>` in a single inline `color`, which cannot render per-run colours or background highlights; replacing `<textarea>` with `contenteditable` would break `selectionStart`/`selectionEnd` code-unit indexing and existing `HTMLTextAreaElement` tests, and a DOM mirror overlay can drift from Canvas 2D `measureText`/`getWrappedTextLines` metrics, whereas letting the static canvas draw the styled runs beneath a transparent-text `<textarea>` reuses the exact canvas run renderer while keeping native `<textarea>` caret/selection and leaving unstyled text editing (`!textRanges?.length`) untouched. (b) In jsdom, `textWysiwyg.test.tsx` asserts deterministically while the editor is open that `editor.style.color` is `"transparent"`, `JSON.parse(editor.dataset.textRanges!)` matches the applied `TextRangeStyle[]`, and `h.app.renderer.getRenderableElements(...).elementsMap.get(textElement.id)?.textRanges` contains the live styled range.

decisions.topic: Representation and omission of `textRanges` on `ExcalidrawTextElement` (FR-1, NFR-1)
decisions.choice: Store styled spans in `textRanges?: readonly TextRangeStyle[]` where `TextRangeStyle = Readonly<{ start: number; end: number; color?: string; highlightColor?: string }>` over UTF-16 code-unit offsets of `originalText`, and omit or `delete` the `textRanges` own property whenever normalized ranges are empty.
rejected: Initializing `textRanges: []` or `textRanges: undefined` as an own property on every `ExcalidrawTextElement`
Indexing ranges against wrapped `element.text` instead of `originalText`
decisions.reason: Vitest snapshots serialize `"textRanges": undefined` if the key exists on the object; omitting and deleting the key when empty guarantees zero snapshot drift, and indexing against `originalText` keeps offsets stable across width/container re-wrapping.

decisions.topic: Applying range colour and highlight from WYSIWYG and properties actions (FR-4)
decisions.choice: Export `getWysiwygSelectionRange` and `syncWysiwygTextRangesStyle` from `packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.tsx`, export `actionChangeHighlightColor` from `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.tsx`, and route `actionChangeStrokeColor`, `actionChangeBackgroundColor`, and `actionChangeHighlightColor` to update `[selectionStart, selectionEnd)` via `applyTextRangeStyle` whenever `appState.editingTextElement` has a non-empty selection (`selectionStart < selectionEnd`), while rendering a Highlight `ColorPicker` inside `actionChangeStrokeColor.PanelComponent` when editing non-sticky text.
rejected: Enabling `getShapeActionPredicates.backgroundColor` for plain text elements while editing
decisions.reason: `stickyNotes.test.tsx` explicitly asserts `getShapeActionPredicates(...).backgroundColor === false` when editing plain text, and `contextmenu`/`history` snapshots forbid new `AppState` keys; reading selection from the live `.excalidraw-wysiwyg` textarea and rendering the highlight picker in `actionChangeStrokeColor.PanelComponent` during plain-text editing satisfies both constraints.
